title: salix caprea f. elongata
intro: Salix caprea f. elongata, commonly known as Goat Willow or Sallow, is a variant of the Goat Willow tree (Salix caprea) that has been elongated due to its unique growth habit. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Salix caprea f. elongata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
